title: Run post-SBP reality check and smart goal
description:
After the SBP visibility/MCP recalibration bead is closed, run a repo-vs-vision reality check followed by a `$smart goal` pass from this repo root.

Prompt to run:
`$reality-check-for-project + $smart goal`

The point is not a brainstorm. Compare implemented code, docs, plans, Beads, and validation commands against the project vision; then write the single most accretive smart-goal contract for the next move. If the pass discovers truly accretive follow-up work, create/update Beads with evidence and dependencies.
design:
concern: post-visibility project truth and next smart goal
writes: Beads issue notes/children and overlay-backed smart-chain artifacts if the repo has a matching invocation root
non_goals: broad brainstorm; implementation before the reality check names the next move
validation: repo-native validation named by the smart goal, plus Beads dependency/state check
acceptance_criteria:
- The SBP recalibration bead is closed or its unresolved blocker is explicitly accepted as not blocking this repo assessment.
- `$reality-check-for-project + $smart goal` was run from the repo root with repo evidence, not vibes.
- The reality check distinguishes implemented state from roadmap/planned state.
- The smart goal names loop_goal, success criteria, resume condition, and validation/commit/reality-check gate.
- Any new follow-up Beads are evidence-backed, dependency-linked, and not duplicates.
- Repo-native validation commands are named or exact blockers are recorded.
notes: Backlog refresh 2026-05-11T23:06:40.021194+00:00: confirmed this repo should have this operational bead.

title: Run SBP skill and MCP visibility recalibration
description:
Run a repo-local `$sbp` recalibration from this repo root before more agent work relies on skill or MCP visibility.

Required read-only pass:
- `sbp`
- `sbp recalibrate`
- `sbp skills --issues-only --no-global --format json`
- `sbp mcp --format json`
- `sbp beads status`

Classify any `missing_for_cwd`, `scope_violations`, `broken_project`, MCP missing/extra/parity drift, and Beads drift. Use narrow dry-runs before applying any sync/remove/prune action. Prefer repo-local fixes; do not do broad global cleanup unless the evidence is specific and recorded here.
design:
concern: Skillbox visibility and MCP parity
writes: project-local skill links, `.mcp.json`, `.codex/config.toml`, repo-local Beads notes only when justified by dry-run evidence
non_goals: broad global pruning; making task skills global to unblock a single run
validation: sbp recalibrate; sbp mcp --format json; sbp beads status
acceptance_criteria:
- SBP read-only commands above were run from the repo root and summarized in issue notes.
- Add/remove/sync decisions are classified by mismatch type and policy reason.
- Any mutation used a reviewed dry-run first, then the narrow apply command only.
- `sbp recalibrate` and `sbp mcp --format json` were rerun after changes, or exact blockers were recorded.
- Remaining human decisions, if any, are explicit.
notes:
Evidence 2026-05-11:
- Claimed issue and ran required read-only pass from /Users/b/repos/opensource/skills.
- `sbp`: active clients=skills, profiles=core/local-all, 17 effective skill occurrences, pwd match skills@/Users/b/repos/opensource/skills.
- `sbp recalibrate`: skill sync dry-run actions none; repo-local skill prune dry-run actions none; beads not required by currently effective skills; MCP audit expected=skillbox with no Claude/Codex missing/parity drift.
- `sbp skills --issues-only --no-global --format json`: missing_for_cwd=0, scope_violations=0, broken_project=0, shadowed=0, global fields intentionally ignored for repo-local scope.
- `sbp mcp --format json`: .mcp.json and .codex/config.toml both present/valid; shared server skillbox; claude_missing=0, codex_missing=0, claude_extra=0, codex_extra=0, claude_only=0, codex_only=0.
- `sbp beads status`: .beads initialized at repo root with prefix skills; no Beads initialization drift.
Decision table:
- missing_for_cwd: none -> no sync.
- scope_violations: none -> no project prune/remove.
- broken_project: none -> no source restore.
- MCP missing/extra/parity: none -> no config edits.
- Beads drift: none -> no bead init/sync mutation needed beyond normal session sync.
No mutations were applied because reviewed dry-runs had no actions. Avoided broad global cleanup as requested.
close_reason: Completed repo-local SBP/MCP visibility recalibration; no mutations needed because read-only audits and dry-runs were clean.

title: Close out mixed skills repo worktree through validation-first commits
description: Smart goal contract for the next highest-leverage move after SBP and reality-check: validation-first closeout of the mixed skills repo worktree.
design:
repo_state:
  branch: drift-detector-multi-family-canonical-2026-05-09
  repo_head: ab0afc9
  compared_to: no prior chain issue
repo_signals:
  - README promises 44 top-level skills, install lanes, overlays, app-backed helpers, and Beads-backed domain execution.
  - Inventory confirms 44 top-level SKILL.md files.
  - SBP/MCP recalibration is clean for repo-local scope: no missing_for_cwd, scope_violations, broken_project, or MCP parity drift.
  - Worktree is still large and mixed: 31 modified tracked files plus untracked .beads, .buildooor, .claude/.codex, MCP config, shared Beads helpers, registry-audit skills, and MMDX artifacts.
  - Reality check found and fixed a concrete divide-and-conquer/SKILL.md corruption before writing this goal.
integrity_gap:
  The repo is operationally promising Beads/source-of-truth execution, but the inherited dirty worktree is not yet reviewable as coherent validated commit batches; bare pytest collection also remains blocked by test harness shape.
hardening_decision:
  hardening-first: closeout, validation, and commit discipline unlock more value than starting another feature.
loop_goal:
  A committed, post-commit-verified checkpoint for the current skills repo work, with unrelated dirty work kept out and all remaining blockers explicit.
completion_gate:
  pending until validate -> commit -> post-commit reality-check passes.
acceptance_criteria:
The exact smart_goal_contract is recorded in issue notes.
The next closeout groups dirty paths into coherent batches and excludes unrelated dirty work.
Touched skills validate with quick_validate, with warnings classified.
Segmented tests pass or blockers are recorded with exact command output.
Bare pytest collection blockers are fixed or tracked as follow-up Beads.
Beads JSONL is flushed and DB/lock/history sidecars remain uncommitted.
Commit(s) are created only after validation, followed by SBP/MCP checks, br ready, and a post-commit reality check.
Detached fresh-eyes review is completed or explicitly blocked before implementation completion is claimed.
notes:
smart_goal_mode: compact-goal
smart_goal_contract: |-
  /goal $commit $reality-check-for-project $skill-issue process complete
  
  One-shot goal: Turn the current mixed Beads/source-of-truth, registry-audit, MMDX, deep-research, and overlay worktree in /Users/b/repos/opensource/skills into reviewable committed checkpoints, without sweeping unrelated dirty work into a commit.
  
  Success criteria:
  - Dirty paths are grouped into documented logical batches: Beads/SBP/MCP bootstrap, domain Beads contract, registry audit skills, MMDX external-action/index support, deep-research prompt toggles, and repo-local overlay behavior.
  - Each batch has explicit included paths, excluded unrelated paths, and a short reason it belongs together.
  - All touched SKILL.md files pass `python3 skill-issue/scripts/quick_validate.py <skill>`, with warnings classified as accepted or converted into follow-up Beads.
  - Repo-native tests pass in their runnable shapes: the segmented Python suite, `PYTHONPATH=mmdx/scripts python3 -m pytest mmdx/scripts/test_mmd.py`, and standalone duplicate-name suites such as `oss-doc-audit/tests/test_select_mode.py`.
  - Bare `python3 -m pytest` collection blockers are either fixed or recorded as evidence-backed follow-up Beads with exact error output.
  - `.beads/issues.jsonl` is flushed, `.beads/*.db*` and local lock/history files remain uncommitted, and Beads status has no ready work left unreported.
  - Coherent commits are created for the validated batches, followed by `sbp recalibrate`, `sbp mcp --format json`, `br ready --json`, and a post-commit reality check.
  - Detached fresh-eyes review is required before completion, and this goal authorizes at least one scoped detached reviewer subagent for that gate, plus additional detached review rounds as needed: launch or route an independent reviewer that did not implement the work, have it inspect the final diff/artifacts/validation evidence, and address or explicitly block on its findings before marking the goal complete.
chain_context:
  First Beads-backed smart goal link in this repo; `br list --label chain:smart --all --json` returned no prior issues.
modes:
  No modes-of-reasoning report was resolved. `resolve_context.py` matched client=skills but did not expose workflow_builder roots; Beads is the durable smart-goal log for this run.
crap_status:
  Not run; no supported hotspot score was needed for this docs/skill closeout decision.
skill_combo:
  reality-check-for-project -> smart goal -> commit closeout -> post-commit reality check
first_step:
  Audit and stage the current dirty worktree by logical batch, starting with the Beads/SBP/MCP bootstrap and the repaired divide-and-conquer/oss-doc-audit validator fixes.
resume_condition:
  Run the closeout goal when ready to batch/stage/commit; another /smart pass is useful after commits and the post-commit reality check, or sooner if path ownership is ambiguous.
reality_check:
  Implemented: 44 skills, SBP/MCP parity, Beads initialized, segmented tests pass, and the divide-and-conquer corruption is fixed. Not yet done: coherent validated commits and bare pytest collection cleanup/follow-up.
close_reason: recommendation delivered as Beads-backed smart goal contract
